{
  "name": "brewmod-plan-effort",
  "version": "6.9.4",
  "description": "Raises the main loop to the configured effort (default xhigh) while in plan mode, by rewriting each request; the session effort setting is never touched (Claude Code 2.1.301+ mod)",
  "author": {
    "name": "Maksim Kochetkov",
    "email": "apmatypa88@gmail.com",
    "url": "https://github.com/kochetkov-ma"
  },
  "homepage": "https://doc-claude.brewcode.app/mods/plan-effort/",
  "repository": "https://github.com/kochetkov-ma/claude-brewcode.git",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "brewmod",
    "mod",
    "plan-mode",
    "effort",
    "xhigh"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "planEffort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Plan effort",
      "description": "Effort for the main loop while in plan mode; raised only, never lowered",
      "options": [
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max"
      ],
      "default": "xhigh"
    }
  },
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
